environment.workbench: production React Router loaders, product components, and command clients

checks: Brief and Petra rendered the same registered SuggestedAction identity
both presentation paths exposed an exact consequence-naming confirmation
uncertain delivery retained and retried byte-equivalent command input
transient feedback dismissed without changing server-owned state
feedback return restored focus to each initiating action control
Petra replayed and resolved a PostgreSQL-backed durable Review interrupt
the durable response returned to the exact originating Work
Review queue and exact session opened through visible links
candidate text correction invoked once and retained a working-only result
material source-basis revision invoked once and reset validation without a decision
the independent prevalidated Review visibly refreshed after the earlier authority effect
Apply preview sent no decision before one explicit Apply
candidate and decision paths returned to the exact originating Work
no browser console or runtime failures

scenario_records.boundary: One isolated Chrome session executed the production Brief, Petra, Work, and Review routes at one stable workbench URL against authenticated live HTTP owners, a certified grounded-synthesis runtime, ArtifactStore bytes, and fresh disposable PostgreSQL. It previewed and invoked the same registered SuggestedAction in both direct and Petra presentations; confirmed the exact consequence; retained byte-equivalent commands across deliberately interrupted response delivery; exercised explicit retry, transient dismissal, and focus return; replayed and resolved a PostgreSQL-backed durable Review interrupt; corrected Review text and basis; visibly refreshed and applied a separate prevalidated exact Review; and returned to the originating Work. Purpose-built disposable records isolate correction from the independently eligible decision; no fixture response, hidden developer command, or client-owned authority substitutes for a production command.

limitations: The retained workbench URL is stable for this isolated execution but stops when the test completes and is not the final long-lived USER-TESTABLE-01 URL.
This focused record does not claim the complete guided-core-path, responsive-accessibility, adverse-state, Graph, Source, History, operations, critic, exit, or user-acceptance scenarios.
The corrected candidate and basis intentionally remain non-authoritative pending validation; Apply executes on a distinct validation-passed Review record.
